name: delegate
description: The main loop only delegates; the mod decides each subagent's model and effort from its brief, with Apple's on-device model and a keyword fallback. Lookups run on haiku at low effort, implementation on sonnet, review and measurement on opus.

classifier.title: Subagent classifier
classifier.description: fm (default): the on-device model reads each Agent brief and names its class; any failure falls back to the keyword rules and is recorded. regex: keyword rules only.

main_mode.title: Main loop mode
main_mode.description: block (default): the main loop's own work tools are refused with a message that says to delegate. warn: allowed, with a toast. off: the mod only routes subagents.

main_allow.title: Extra tools the main loop may use
main_allow.description: Comma-separated tool names the main loop keeps besides the orchestration tools. A trailing * matches a prefix (mcp__my_server__*).
